honest_c3_caveats: C1_terminal_ui_not_tk — presenter is terminal-fullscreen ANSI not Tk fullscreen (spec mentions Tk but does not require it); UX preserved (spacebar + min-dwell + ESC) but on-screen text is monospace + may wrap differently than Tk centered Helvetica. Reading-task validity: same content, same self-paced advance, same eyes-on-screen attention demand.

C2_lsl_marker_consumed_by_what — collect.hexa direct BrainFlow path does NOT consume the LSL marker stream (collect.hexa doesn't currently have --lsl-marker-listen). Markers are emitted on the LSL outlet and stored in main_protocol_stimulus_log.jsonl with monotonic_ns timestamps. F-PHASE-E-2 sync verification (spec §7 P5) is performed POST-HOC by the analyzer cross-correlating presenter onset_ns with EEG sample timestamps + (if available) the AUX channel 17 audio sync pulse — not by real-time LSL inlet on EEG side. This means the LSL outlet itself is currently a *fallback* sync path; primary sync is via shared monotonic clock on the same Mac.

C3_audio_sync_aux_channel_not_implemented — spec §3 calls for 50ms 2kHz tone on AUX channel 17 for cross-modal sync verification; this script does NOT generate the audio pulse. F-PHASE-E-2 falls back to LSL/monotonic-clock latency only. If wall-clock drift between presenter process + EEG capture process exceeds 50ms, F-PHASE-E-2 may FAIL even on real binding. Mitigation: same-Mac single-process group launches both, so jitter is bounded by macOS scheduler (~1-5ms typical).

C4_no_alcohol_attest_gate_in_script — spec §5 requires user_attest.json (alcohol-free 24-48h, sleep≥6h, caffeine-free 4h, exercise-free 2h, 5-min stabilize) before P1; this script does NOT check user_attest.json before launching. User must self-attest. Analysis-pipeline §7 P0 validate WILL refuse to emit verdict if user_attest.json missing — so post-hoc gate exists but pre-hoc human-trust gate is not enforced.

C5_corpus_substitution_disclosed — spec §3 §C8 originally suggested ZuCo SR transcript shuffle for methodological homology with BLM Phase 5 EEG side; this corpus is instead anima-axis-conditioned (5-bucket × 60). The cross-fold-in to BLM Phase 5 ZuCo analysis is therefore weaker than spec ideal — but verdict gate (F-PHASE-E-1, F-PHASE-E-2) is corpus-agnostic so Phase E binding witness criterion is unchanged.

C6_125hz_not_500hz — Cyton+Daisy native 125Hz (per actual hardware in berger_ec_60s.npy.meta.json) vs spec §4 'sampling_rate_hz: 250' assumption vs ZuCo 500Hz. The post-onset 250-300ms epoch window contains only ~6 samples per channel × 4 channels = 24 samples at 125Hz, even narrower than spec C1 caveat anticipated. High-gamma (30-80Hz) coherence estimation at this window-length is borderline; analyzer must flag.

C7_fire_is_user_only — this BG does NOT fire main_protocol_run.bash. User must run the fire_command manually after sitting in front of EEG cap with electrodes attached, head-ache subsided, and 5-min stabilize done. ready_to_run=true means the artifacts are in place; it does NOT mean the user is ready.
